titre: Le lit au milieu de la cour
lieu: shared courtyard of a cour commune in Angré, Abidjan, a row of numbered tenant doors, a single metal bed with a thin mattress standing in the middle of the courtyard, a plastic water barrel, morning

persos.pose: standing in the foreground on the left, basin on her hip, frowning

persos.desc: tenant man in his 30s, lime-and-copper tracksuit, short beard, sitting cross-legged on the metal bed, empty hands
persos.pose: sitting on the bed on the right, arms crossed, very calm

dialogue: Vieux père, ton lit-là fait quoi dans la cour ?!
Bailleur a dit : sors de ma maison.
Et tu pars quand, dêh ?
Il a dit sors. Il a pas dit pars.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The neighbor, in the foreground, points at the bed with her free hand and asks, outraged. The tenant answers calmly, shrugging, still seated cross-legged. The neighbor puts her free hand on her hip and asks again. The tenant raises one finger like a lawyer and says his last line proudly, his face clearly visible.
chute: The neighbor freezes, her mouth wide open, the basin still on her hip. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the curious neighbor woman's stunned face looking into the camera.
